function.description: Record the OWNER's durable facts and STANDING RULES — their timezone, projects, and how they want you to operate (a small owner.md, ≤24000 chars). It holds preferences and policy, NOT on/off switch states or job ids. It is the file owner.md in your identity directory (<data_dir>/identity/<instance>/user_<id>/, next to self.md); action='read' returns it with its path — never search the disk for it. action='update' replaces it (consolidate, keep only durable facts); action='patch' edits the ACTIVE rules by exact-string replace (the '## Superseded' history is never patched); Draft activation requires owner review through /pending. On any turn an update/patch is queued for review. Pass source= (where the fact came from: 'owner said', 'measured', 'room_read') and observed_at=YYYY-MM-DD (defaults to today) so each new or changed line is written with its provenance; that stamp counts toward the char cap. A line that CLAIMS something about the world (broken, blocked, disabled, lacks permission, since …) may be refused without a source. action='sweep' with content=<a rule> lists every standing instruction that appears to contradict it — owner rules, SOUL, skills, cron/goal task text and workspace docs marked `kind: instruction` (records are never swept). Advisory: it changes nothing. A rule you record is swept for you.
function.name: owner_doc_manage
